## The contradiction (production read vs landed record)

`sig-alerts` mounts `sig-alert-webhook-token` (`pre/service-sig-alerts.json`);
`ops/iam_identities.toml` declares `sig-alerts-rt` "no project roles, no
secret access" and omits it from that secret's `consumers`. That is the
contract's voided-by clause — a production read contradicting a record — so
the leg stopped, rolled back, and routed the decision to **`D-P34.42a-1`
(OPEN)**: amend the declaration so `sig-alerts-rt` consumes that one secret
(the least-privilege truth), then re-run the verbatim leg on
`r11/P34.42a-live-2`.

## Post-rollback verification (10:08:57Z)

`post-rollback/` capture matches `pre/` field-for-field (identities, digests,
env, IAM policies, SA list, bindings) and `sig-ops route-compare verify`
reports **39/39 routes byte-identical per service**. Production is exactly
the recorded prestate; nothing dangles.
